name: @platform-blocks/ui
description: A comprehensive React Native UI component library — 80+ accessible, themeable, cross-platform components for iOS, Android, and Web

scripts.build: npm run clean && rollup -c --forceExit && npm run build:types
scripts.prepare: sh -c 'if [ "$BUILD_ON_PREPARE" = "1" ]; then npm run build; else echo "ui: skipping build on prepare (set BUILD_ON_PREPARE=1 to enable)"; fi'
scripts.precommit: npm run lint:check && npm run test

author: Josh Stovall
